01 / About

Hello, I’m
Baban Gain.

I am a doctoral researcher and Prime Minister's Research Fellow at the Indian Institute of Technology Patna. My research sits at the intersection of machine translation, multilingual natural language processing, and model merging.

Machine Translation Multilingual NLP Low-resource Languages Large Language Models Model Merging
